rows.before: A CCPC pays something like 12.2% combined here below the $500,000 active business limit, where you would pay 53.53% at the top personally — but the saving survives only on money left in.
rows.after: A CCPC pays something like 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) combined here below the $500,000 active business limit, where you would pay 53.53% at the top personally — but the saving survives only on money left in.
rows.note: First R1 change on page; parenthetical added.

rows.after: Roughly 11.2% combined in Ontario, up to the $500,000 active business limit, against 53.53% personally, is a genuine gap.
